facts.fact: 开头：在 Oro Rosa 餐厅，Jordan 期待甜点后妈妈终于要讲搬家的真相。
facts.anchor: When the server at Oro Rosa brought out Jordan’s dessert, she was filled with anticipation.

facts.fact: Jordan 期待妈妈告诉她全家搬往加拿大背后的真实原因。
facts.anchor: but also because her mom was finally going to tell her the real story behind their move to Canada

facts.fact: 晚餐时父母争吵，妈妈骂爸爸是骗子，Jordan 吹口哨制止他们。
facts.anchor: I’d rather be inconsistent and a quitter than a liar. Like you.

facts.fact: 奶奶 Nan 突然现身餐厅，Jordan 从家中墙上的相框认出了她。
facts.anchor: Jordan said, recognizing her from one of the photo frames that hung on the wall at home.

facts.fact: Nan 道出真相：Jordan 的爸爸投资失败，几乎亏光自家的钱和 Nan 的钱。
facts.anchor: Apparently my dad made a bad investment. He lost almost all our money, and some of Nan’s, too.

facts.fact: 听完家族秘密后 Jordan 心绪翻涌，像十英尺高的海浪般冲击着她。
facts.anchor: All that remained were feelings that kept crashing over her like ten-foot waves.

facts.fact: 中段：Jordan 总结 Lily 的理论——有野生动物被偷运上岛并逃脱，管理层在掩盖。
facts.anchor: your theory is a wild animal was smuggled onto the island for some unknown reason and is now on the loose

facts.fact: 结尾：三人立下新约定——余下整个假期无论发生什么都要团结在一起。
facts.anchor: We stick together throughout the rest of the vacation. No matter what happens on our adventure.
